findings.label: Missing AdminModal component
findings.description: Referenced by ProjectsPage and EducationPage, will cause runtime error when users try to edit items. Must be created at `src/components/admin/AdminModal.jsx`.

findings.label: Missing MessagesPage component
findings.description: Referenced in App.jsx routes and AdminLayout navigation, will cause runtime error when navigating to the messages tab. Must be created at `src/pages/admin/MessagesPage.jsx`.

findings.label: Missing adminHelpers utility
findings.description: DashboardPage imports `parseErrorMessage` from `adminHelpers.js` which does not exist. Will fail on error. Must be created at `src/utils/adminHelpers.js` with the function exported.

findings.label: JWT_SECRET weak in .env
findings.description: Backend .env contains `JWT_SECRET=your_jwt_secret_key`, a placeholder string. Should be a strong random secret. Replace before production deployment.
